title: Crown Clash 3D
game_overview: A high-octane 3D arena fighter with fast aerial juggles, multi-form morphing weapons, super cancels, and fluid esports duel combat.
winning_condition: Deplete the opponent's health bar to zero across arena match rounds.
losing_condition: Player health reaches zero before defeating the opponent.

controls.action: Move character in full 3D space across the arena
Jump into the air (supports double jump and air control)
Guard against frontal attacks or trigger mid-air recovery tech
Execute Class Skill 1 (e.g., Piercing Thrust or Dragon Lunger)
Execute Class Skill 2 (e.g., Sky Soar Launcher / Aerial Juggler)
Execute Class Skill 3 (e.g., Whirling Sweep / Form Special)
Morph Omniform Weapon between Spear, Cannon, Staff, and Shield
Unleash Ultimate Super Move with cinematic camera zoom

sections.title: Design Pillars
sections.content: 1. Expressive 3D Combat: Full XZ plane omnidirectional mobility with 3D hitboxes, dynamic launch vectors, aerial juggles, and OTG interactions. 2. Weapon Morphing Mastery: Instant form transformations that cancel recovery windows for high-skill ceiling play. 3. Cinematic Game Feel: Responsive hit-stop frames, camera punch, slash trails, dynamic lighting, and spectator esports immersion.
sections.summary: Core guiding tenets of high-speed competitive 3D arena combat.

sections.title: Core Loop
sections.content: Players select their class and battle in 3D arenas across Training Mode and Best-of-3 Esports Tournaments. Combatants utilize neutral footsies, launchers, aerial juggles, super cancels, and defense techs. Depleting the rival's HP wins the round and triggers slow-motion KO replay camera shots.
sections.summary: The moment-to-moment fighting cycle and match progression.

sections.title: Core Mechanics
sections.content: 1. 4-Hit Basic Attack String: Smooth chaining normals cancelable into special skills. 2. Aerial Juggles & Decay: Launchers send opponents airborne; consecutive mid-air hits accumulate Juggle Decay until hard fall reset. 3. Multi-Form Morphing: Omniform weapon transforms between Spear (melee rush), Cannon (ranged artillery), Staff (AoE elements), and Shield (perfect guard counter). 4. Air Tech & Super Armor: Recover from launches using L/Tech; heavy skills grant poise through incoming hits.
sections.summary: Combat mechanics including launch vectors, juggle decay, hit-stop, and cancels.

sections.title: 3D Camera & Movement Alignment
sections.content: 3D Coordinate System: Right-handed system (+Y is Up, +X is Right, -Z is Forward). Dynamic Camera: Continuously tracks the midpoint between combatants, adjusting distance and elevation dynamically based on character separation and height. Super activations trigger cinematic close-ups and slow-motion freeze frames before resuming normal tracking.
sections.summary: Midpoint tracking camera with cinematic dynamic framing and 3D coordinate convention.

sections.title: 3D Scene & Environment Structure
sections.content: Environments include a grand ancient stone arena with torchlights and pillars, and a high-tech neon esports stadium with pulsating floor grids and animated spectator silhouettes. Lighting features key directional sunlight with soft shadow maps, hemisphere ambient fill, and colored rim lights. Post-processing delivers bloom on energy effects, subtle vignette, and radial hit blurs.
sections.summary: Procedural colosseums and glowing esports arenas with soft shadows and post-processing.

sections.title: Characters & Enemies
sections.content: 1. Omniform Prodigy: Master of all martial forms wielding a morphing mechanical apparatus. 2. Arcane Lancer: Spear combo specialist emphasizing high mobility, dragon-aura thrusts, and aerial dive crashes. 3. Training Dummy: Non-retaliating sparring partner displaying real-time damage, combo count, and juggle meters. 4. Tactical AI: Features 3 difficulty tiers with spacing, sidestepping, hit confirms, and air tech recovery.
sections.summary: Detailed articulated 3D character rigs with distinct martial classes and AI archetypes.

sections.title: Fairness Tools
sections.content: Clear telegraphing of unblockable or super-armor attacks via character emissive glowing shaders; on-screen Juggle Decay meter showing juggle escape thresholds; distinct audio-visual cue for perfect guard timings.
sections.summary: Visual indicators and mechanics ensuring competitive fairness.

sections.title: Juice & Game Feel
sections.content: Anticipation Juice: Character rig joint wind-ups and weapon charge glows. State Change Juice: Form transformation mechanical particle bursts, running dust clouds, and jump launch shockwaves. Impact Juice: 3 to 6 frame hit-stop freezes, multi-tier screen shake, white flash material overrides, ribbon weapon motion trails, floating 3D Chinese combat damage numbers, and combo rating announcements.
sections.summary: Satisfying audio-visual feedback on every attack and defensive action.

sections.title: Social Mechanics & Audience
sections.content: Appeals to fans of high-speed 3D fighters and competitive gaming. Features detailed post-match APM and combo statistics.
sections.summary: Single-player esports challenge with local training and leaderboard integration.

sections.title: Accessibility
sections.content: Full key rebinding interface, virtual touch HUD with dedicated action buttons for mobile devices, graphic quality toggles (Low, Med, High), and audio volume sliders.
sections.summary: Customizable inputs and responsive mobile adaptation.

sections.title: Structural Integrity
sections.content: MMO Login Main Menu (荣耀巅峰) -> Class Selection with 3D rotating character inspection -> Mode Select (Training / AI Arena / Tournament) -> 3D Combat Viewport -> Victory/Defeat Results with APM, damage output, and combo statistics.
sections.summary: Menu flow from MMO-styled login screen to class selection and battle results.

sections.title: Virtual Touch Controls Implementation
sections.content: Renders an on-screen virtual joystick / D-pad on the bottom-left and circular action buttons (Attack, Jump, Guard, Skills 1-3, Morph, Super) on the bottom-right. Handles pointer events with touch-none and high z-index.
sections.summary: Dedicated responsive touch interface for mobile devices.
